subject: Renewal amendment: 18-month term + capacity uplift — MSA & Order Form clarifications
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal amendment: 18-month term + capacity uplift — draft order form

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on target usage for H2. Per our discussion, attached is a clean Order Form v3 that implements the 18-month term (start 2027-09-01), the +35% capacity uplift for streaming inference, and the proposed credit bucket for pre-paid overage protection.

Quick summary of what changed from v2: 
- Term: 18 months (auto-renew opt-out at month 16 with 60 days' notice)
- Capacity: baseline units increased 35% (line items 2–4)
- Credits: $25k pre-paid credits for burst usage, applied on top of monthly committed usage
- Pricing: unit price unchanged; see Pricing_Credits_Schedule.xlsx for math

Can you confirm the procurement team needs a tracked MSA amendment alongside this order form? Karthik and Mina are on copy to help with legal language and any SLO exception requests.

Attachments: ACME_Renewal_Orderform_v3.pdf, Pricing_Credits_Schedule.xlsx

Proposed next steps:
1) Your procurement confirms any material changes (SLA, billing cadence) by EOD Thurs 8/5
2) We circulate a tracked MSA amendment if needed (Mina to prepare)
3) Target DocuSign before 8/20 so services ramp on 9/1

Thanks —
Logan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acmeinc.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment: 18-month term + capacity uplift — draft order form

Logan —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the summary. A few procurement/finance items up front: 
- Procurement asks for billing to remain monthly but want net-45 payment terms. Can you confirm Redwood is ok with net-45 for the 18-month term?
- Finance is asking how the pre-paid $25k credits are reflected on invoices (separate line item + balance report).
- Legal will want a tracked amendment to the current MSA; they typically require explicit language for data residency, audit rights, and incident notification timing.

I've attached procurement's initial comment list as inline notes — high level now, I'll circulate to our legal counsel and get more detailed redlines by Thursday. Also: our procurement lead is out on Thu-Fri, so responses might be a little wobbly — expect consolidated feedback by EOD 8/5.

Elena
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Inc.

Attachments: ACME_Procurement_InitialNotes.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acmeinc.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment: 18-month term + capacity uplift — billing and credits clarifications

Elena — thanks for the early notes. A couple quick clarifications from commercial: 
- Net-45 is acceptable for this renewal provided we maintain the committed capacity billing cadence (monthly invoice for committed units + detailed credits reconciliation). We'll need a short approval from Revenue Ops but I'm confident we can move forward.
- The $25k pre-paid credits will appear as a separate invoice line with a running balance applied against overages; we'll provide a monthly credits statement. See attached Pricing_Credits_Schedule.xlsx for the accounting mock.

Regarding the MSA amendment: Mina, can you draft a tracked amendment that includes: 
  * explicit data residency confirmation (US only for Acme)
  * audit support window (30 days notice for SOC/audit requests)
  * incident notification SLA (24 hours initial notification + 72 hours RCA)
  * the billing/payment language specifying net-45 term for this order form only

If Acme has any mandatory wording, please paste it into the redlines so we can reconcile. We aim to have a legal-ready draft for review by EOD 8/5.

—Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Pricing_Credits_Schedule.xlsx
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acmeinc.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment: 18-month term + capacity uplift — MSA amendment (tracked)

Hi all —

I've attached a tracked-changes MSA amendment (MSA_Amendment_TrackedChanges.docx) that maps the key commercial terms into legal language. High-level notes on items I added or flagged: 
- Data residency: included explicit US-only processing and a paragraph referencing our KMS-based encryption (customer-managed keys optional via enterprise add-on).
- Audit rights: added 30-day notice and a scope definition (log samples, SOC report access). Redlines flag any requests for full system access — we will route those through support/legal.
- Incident notifications: I used 24/72 as Karthik suggested. If Acme requests a shorter RCA timeframe, we should get engineering confirmation for feasibility.
- Net-45: I inserted temporary payment term language scoped to this Order Form only; finance must approve before signature.

Outstanding items for Acme input (please paste exact language where required): 
1) Any mandatory procurement clause we must accept (escape clauses, insurance thresholds).
2) Exact contact for SOC report delivery (email + SFTP?)
3) Confirmation that Acme will accept the credits format (line item + monthly statement)

If procurement signs off on the tracked doc by EOD, I can prepare a clean final for signature and push to DocuSign.

Attachments: MSA_Amendment_TrackedChanges.docx

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@acmeinc.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment: 18-month term + capacity uplift — procurement confirmation

Mina / team —

Thanks for the tracked draft, Mina. Legal reviewed and provided inline comments; there are three small asks: 
- Add explicit language that audit access excludes source code and live customer data (we'll propose a narrow log sample scope).
- For incident RCA, change 72 hours -> 5 business days for the formal RCA; initial notification still 24 hours.
- Procurement requests to cap total liability at the existing MSA threshold (no change).

Procurement confirms net-45 is acceptable for this renewal given the annual spend and internal approvals. We'll consolidate our redlines into a single document and upload to your Drive link by Friday 8/6. If you can incorporate the small asks above and send a final clean version, we can get DocuSign set up next week.

Elena
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Inc.
